gloss: as one wishes; at one's will; freely

definitions.gloss: as one wishes; at one's will; at one's pleasure
definitions.explanation: Describes doing something exactly as one wants, having full control over a situation or being able to act without restriction.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{人|ひと}を{意|い}のままに{操|あやつ}る。
examples.english: He manipulates people as he pleases.

examples.japanese: {自然|しぜん}は{人間|にんげん}の{意|い}のままにならない。
examples.english: Nature doesn't bend to human will.

examples.japanese: {権力者|けんりょくしゃ}は{国|くに}を{意|い}のままに{支配|しはい}しようとした。
examples.english: The ruler tried to control the country as he saw fit.

notes:
Combines {意|い} (intention, will) with のまま (as is, unchanged). Expresses having complete control or freedom to do as one wishes. Often used when describing someone exerting power or influence over others or situations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {意|い}のままに{操|あやつ}る: to manipulate at will
- {意|い}のままにする: to do as one pleases with
- {意|い}のままにならない: to not go as one wishes
- {意|い}のままに{動|うご}く: to move as one wills

USAGE:
Often carries a slightly literary or dramatic tone. Common in narratives about power, control, and freedom. The negative form {意|い}のままにならない is very common, expressing frustration that things aren't going as planned.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {思|おも}いのまま: as one feels/desires — similar but slightly more emotional
- {思|おも}い{通|どお}りに: as one expects — focuses on things matching expectations
- {自由自在|じゆうじざい}に: freely, at will — emphasizes skillful control
- {好|す}きなように: however one likes — more casual
